envelope.description: Clean preserved story checkpoints after successful BUILD approval

body.title: Clean preserved story checkpoints after successful BUILD approval
body.summary: Integrate post-success BUILD approval and retry cleanup with t1 authority and existing lifecycle. Under short story fence enumerate bounded no-follow literal checkpoint files; derive canonical project/Plan epic/story identity and validate all completed attempts against durable task CR before unlink. Preserve unfinished/unrepresented/unknown/foreign files and active work with explicit retained/retryable metadata. No caller deletion paths, artifact schema changes or cleanup before success; preserve current BUILD approval freshness fixes. Use a reusable canonical post-success approval hook with injected delegation to owner, not daemon imports in workflow domain code; direct/outer single/batch routes share it.
acceptanceChecks: Single, batch and direct story BUILD approval trigger cleanup only after approval succeeds and required CR history is preserved; earlier task validation/CR publication/rejected approval cannot delete files.
All safe matching task/story review ids are deleted; unrelated projects/stories, symlinks, corrupt/future/oversized files and unfinished/unrepresented history remain with reasons.
Concurrent starts/admissions/publications cannot race deletion; active same-story work defers cleanup without revoking approval or blocking unrelated stories.
Per-file unlink failures report deleted/retained/errors; repeated approval retries without model calls, BUILD regeneration or changed review fingerprints.

tests.name: Successful story BUILD approval removes only matching fully preserved task/story checkpoints
Cleanup defers for active admission/execution/publication and excludes concurrent starts under story fence
Rejected approval, task validation and CR publication never clean checkpoints; repeated approval retries partial cleanup
Cleanup retains malformed/symlink/foreign/future/unrepresented history and reports filesystem failures
